color.summary: Navy on white. Ink is a navy-black, #000c1f, and most neutrals are that ink at an alpha: body copy at 65% (#59616d on white), quiet text at 45% (#8c919a), edges at 10% (#e5e6e8) and 45%. Tints are blue-700 at 5% (#f2f4f7) and 10%. The primary is navy #002664 and links are blue #0066c5. Dark is #0b0d12 with white ink at the same alphas; the primary lifts to #0066c5 and links to #66aef5.
usage: Status colors are kept for the content: red #d80007, green #007f26 and yellow #8e5e00 in light, #ff5252, #0aa93a and #e99b00 in dark.

type.summary: Helvetica Now Text for UI and body (16/24, prose tracked -0.48px), Helvetica Now Display for larger UI (the Menu sheet's 32px entries at 500, 24px section titles at 400), and the serif Rhymes Text for headlines: 64px with -3.2px tracking for section heads, 96px on the FAQ page. Buttons are 16px at 500. Both families are proprietary.

shape.summary: Round. Every button is a pill and icon buttons are circles. Dialogs and the Menu sheet have 40px corners, textareas 16px, small ghost links 8px. Bento tiles use a squircle (corner-shape: superellipse), so a 48px radius computes 57.3px. The radius scale runs 4 to 64px.

spacing.summary: A 4px grid, with buttons in three steps: 44px with 20px padding (Menu, Show all), 56px with 24px (forms, section actions) and 64px with 36px at 18px for hero actions. Icon buttons are 36, 48 and 56px circles.

elevation.summary: One soft shadow, elevation-1: 0 10px 40px in navy (#010e24) at 8%, black at 15% in dark. Widgets (tooltips, the Submit feedback dialog, the report flow's cards) pair it with a 1px ring of ink at 5%; the Menu sheet uses three longer drops instead. Dialogs sit over a 20% black backdrop with a 12px blur, and the Menu button and media controls blur what's behind them by 25px. Focus is a 2px white band inside a 2px #0c0c0c ring, in both modes.

button.summary: Pills at every size: navy for the main action, a 5% blue tint for the others, ghosts for icons in the chat composer. They press to 98%. Much of the home page is illustration drawn from scaled-down copies of these parts; those are left out.
